title: LexsiTrack2PromptEntry
description: Standard schema for manual seeds and expanded attack/benign prompts.

parent_id.description: Parent prompt ID if derived/expanded, null for root manual seeds.

attack_family.description: Family of the attack (e.g. roleplay, hypothetical_research, obfuscation, multi_turn_escalation, brainrot_masking).

category.description: Harm category (e.g. cyber_exploit, cbrn, hate_harassment, fraud, disinformation).

attack_prompt.description: The adversarial prompt designed to test safety.

benign_twin_prompt.description: Benign twin prompt in the SAME language and register to verify comprehension without refusal.

notes.description: Optional notes from curator or pipeline.
